text: dsh-delete-guard 是面向 DSH Web 的 Windows 插件，在工具执行前检查 pwsh、bash、cmd 和持久终端等命令，并注册 file_trash 与 trash_status 两个工具。识别到可重定向的删除命令时，它会拒绝原调用并提示通过 file_trash 将目标移入系统回收站；trash_status 可查询指定驱动器的回收站项目数和占用空间。适合希望在 DSH 中使用可恢复删除流程并查看回收站状态的 Windows 用户。需要 Windows 环境和 PowerShell，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-delete-guard adds recoverable deletion to DSH Web on Windows. It checks shell commands and routes recognized deletions to file_trash, which moves paths to the Recycle Bin. trash_status reports a drive’s item count and used space. Requires Windows and PowerShell; no API key or account.
希望 DSH 删除文件时先走 Windows 回收站，方便之后还原。
怎么查看某个磁盘的回收站里有多少项目、占了多少空间？
Can DSH route a shell deletion through the Windows Recycle Bin so I can restore it later?
dsh-delete-guard 的功能「删除命令转入回收站」：在工具执行前检查支持的 shell 命令；遇到可解析的删除目标时拒绝原调用，并提示改用 file_trash 将路径移入系统回收站。
dsh-delete-guard 的功能「查看回收站占用」：调用 trash_status 并可提供驱动器盘符，返回该卷回收站中的项目数量和占用字节数。

**让 agent 删不掉「恢复不了」的东西。**

删除只有两条路：进 Windows 回收站（资源管理器里能还原），或者被拦下来换成一次
`file_trash` 调用。没有第三条。

```
agent:  Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\src
被拒:    The delete guard blocked this delete. Re-run this as: file_trash with paths = ["…\src"]
随后:    file_trash → 移入回收站，「还原」可用
```

dsh-delete-guard README · 解决什么问题：DSH 里模型执行 `pwsh` 的删除命令，文件是被直接抹掉的：`ctx.fs` 没有 delete，
`ctx.shell` 只有 `execute()`，没有任何中间层。一句 `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force`
就能带走一整个目录，没有回收站，没有撤销。

本插件挂在 `tools/pre-execute`（宿主真正路由每个工具调用的接缝），把这些调用**拒绝**，
并告诉模型改用 `file_trash`；后者用 `SHFileOperationW(FOF_ALLOWUNDO)` 移动文件——和资源
管理器删文件是同一套 Win32 API，所以 `$Recycle.Bin` 的 `$I`/`$R` 元数据正确，「还原」可用。

挡住的不只是 `Remove-Item`：管道、`xargs`、变量拼接的目标、写在 `if { }` 里的删除、内联
`-Command` / `-EncodedCommand`、持久终端里敲的命令、Git Bash 的 `/c/...` 路径、以及清空
回收站的各种写法，各有对应规则。

dsh-delete-guard README · 挡住什么：**会进回收站（被重定向）**

```
Remove-Item C:\tmp\a.txt        del / erase / rd / rmdir / rm / unlink
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\tmp\dir
if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Force }
terminal_send: "Remove-Item C:\tmp\a.txt"

**直接拒绝**

dsh-delete-guard README · 挡住什么：| 类别 | 例子 |
| --- | --- |
| 目标不可枚举（没法证明搬对东西） | `Remove-Item $(…)`、`… \| Remove-Item`、`xargs rm`、`Remove-Item @targets`、`-Recurse C:\tmp\*` |
| 危险路径 | `C:\`、`\`、`C:\Windows`、`Program Files`、`..\..\`、Git Bash 的 `~` / `/tmp` |
| 无删除动词的擦除 | `[System.IO.File]::Delete(…)`、`Invoke-Expression "…"`、`cmd /c del`、`robocopy /MIR`、`find -delete` |
| 永久擦除工具 | `shred`、`sdelete`、`srm`、`cipher /w`、`format X:`（只按程序位置判定） |
| 清空回收站 | `Clear-RecycleBin`（含 `&`、子壳、`-EncodedCommand` 形态）、`SHEmptyRecycleBin`、对回收站条目驱动 shell 动词、直接删 `$Recycle.Bin` 内容 |
| 没有回收站的位置 | UNC 共享、exFAT/FAT32 卷（在那里"回收"等于永久擦除） |
| 脚本内删除 | 内联 shell / Python / Node 体里的删除动词与擦除调用；把含删除的文本写进 `.ps1`/`.sh`/`.py` |

dsh-delete-guard README · 挡住什么：**放行**：只读命令、只提到删除词的操作（`Select-String -Pattern "Remove-Item"`、
`Get-Content shred.exe`）、以及从回收站**还原**文件。

dsh-delete-guard README · 两个工具：| 工具 | 作用 |
| --- | --- |
| `file_trash { paths, reason? }` | 唯一允许的删除方式。移入回收站，逐条报告成功与失败，绝不降级成永久删除 |
| `trash_status { drive? }` | 报告该卷回收站的项目数与占用，用于确认删除确实落进了回收站 |

dsh-delete-guard README · 配置：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖（`config` 是整块替换，要保留的键必须重述）：

| 键 | 默认 | 含义 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `blockDestructiveCommands` | `true` | 拦截 shell 删除并重定向到 `file_trash` |
| `forbidEmptyRecycleBin` | `true` | 禁止清空或改动回收站 |
| `forbidWipe` | `true` | 禁止 `shred` / `sdelete` / `srm` / `cipher /w` / `format` |
| `blockScriptDeletes` | `true` | 禁止脚本文件与内联字符串里的删除 |

dsh-delete-guard README · 恢复已删的文件：恢复不是插件的功能，也不需要——回收站是操作系统的。脚本里这样还原（与界面语言无关）：

1. 读 `X:\$Recycle.Bin\<SID>\$I*` 记录：偏移 24 是原路径字符数，偏移 28 起是 UTF-16LE 原路径；
2. 按原路径匹配到目标条目，取配对的 `$R` 文件；
3. `Move-Item` 搬回原位。

`$R`/`$I` 的文件名是随机的（`$R3LCXYR.txt`），原文件名不在文件名里，只能靠解析 `$I`
反查；动词还原后可能残留孤儿 `$I` 记录，跳过 payload 缺失的即可。资源管理器里右键
「还原」与之一致，只是脚本化时别依赖本地化的动词名。

dsh-delete-guard README · 不挡什么：| 不覆盖 | 原因 |
| --- | --- |
| 脚本文件里已有的删除（守卫从未见过内容） | 只能拒绝写入与看得见的内联形态，不能执行期改写 |
| `Add-Type` 里写任意 C#（如 `DeleteFileW`） | 文本判定够不到；只有针对回收站的 API 被点名拦掉 |
| 命令名先拼进变量再 `& $c` 调用 | 文本层面无法求值 |
| 表格外工具名的执行通道（自定义 shell 工具、第三方插件） | 覆盖名单是显式的，见下 |
| 终端里分两次发送才拼出的删除 | 每次 send 只看到这一次的文本 |
| 非 Windows 平台 | 桥接是 `SHFileOperationW` |
| 空余空间不足时的删除 | NTFS 同卷回收是 rename，不占新空间，没有可预检的东西 |

dsh-delete-guard README · 不挡什么：覆盖的 shell 工具名：`pwsh`、`powershell`、`cmd`、`bash`、`sh`、`zsh`、`shell`、
`terminal_send`、`terminal_write`。判定看的是语句的命令词、调用的形态和程序位置，不是「这一行里出现过这个词」。

dsh-delete-guard README · 测试：```shell

dsh-delete-guard README · dsh-delete-guard：**English** | [简体中文](README.md) | [日本語](README.ja.md)

**An agent cannot delete what it cannot recover.**

A deletion has exactly two outcomes here: it lands in the Windows Recycle Bin
(restorable from Explorer), or it is refused and re-issued as a `file_trash`
call. There is no third one.

dsh-delete-guard README · dsh-delete-guard：```
agent:   Remove-Item -Recurse -Force .\src
refused: The delete guard blocked this delete. Re-run this as: file_trash with paths = ["…\src"]
then:    file_trash → moved to the Recycle Bin, "Restore" works
```

dsh-delete-guard README · The problem：In DSH a model's `pwsh` delete erases files outright: `ctx.fs` has no delete,
`ctx.shell` has only `execute()`, and nothing sits in between. One
`Remove-Item -Recurse -Force` takes a directory with it — no bin, no undo.

dsh-delete-guard README · The problem：This plugin hooks `tools/pre-execute` (the seam the host actually routes every
tool call through), **refuses** those calls, and tells the model to use
`file_trash`. That tool moves items with `SHFileOperationW(FOF_ALLOWUNDO)` — the
same Win32 call Explorer uses — so the `$I`/`$R` metadata in `$Recycle.Bin` is
correct and Restore works.

dsh-delete-guard README · The problem：Coverage goes past `Remove-Item`: pipelines, `xargs`, variable-built targets,
`if { }` blocks, inline `-Command` / `-EncodedCommand`, the persistent terminal,
Git Bash `/c/...` paths, and every spelling of emptying the bin.

text:
dsh-delete-guard README · What it blocks：**Redirected into the Recycle Bin**

```
Remove-Item C:\tmp\a.txt        del / erase / rd / rmdir / rm / unlink
Remove-Item -Recurse -Force C:\tmp\dir
if (Test-Path $p) { Remove-Item $p -Force }
terminal_send: "Remove-Item C:\tmp\a.txt"

**Refused outright**

dsh-delete-guard README · What it blocks：| Category | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| Targets that cannot be proven | `Remove-Item $(…)`, `… \| Remove-Item`, `xargs rm`, `Remove-Item @targets`, `-Recurse C:\tmp\*` |
| Dangerous paths | `C:\`, `\`, `C:\Windows`, `Program Files`, `..\..\`, Git Bash `~` and `/tmp` |
| Erases with no delete verb | `[System.IO.File]::Delete(…)`, `Invoke-Expression "…"`, `cmd /c del`, `robocopy /MIR`, `find -delete` |
| Permanent-erase tools | `shred`, `sdelete`, `srm`, `cipher /w`, `format X:` (matched in program position only) |
| Emptying the bin | `Clear-RecycleBin` (bare, `&`, child shell, `-EncodedCommand`), `SHEmptyRecycleBin`, driving bin items' shell verbs, deleting `$Recycle.Bin` contents |
| Locations without a bin | UNC shares and exFAT/FAT32 volumes, where "recycling" is a permanent erase |
| Deletes inside scripts | shell / Python / Node inline bodies, and writing delete text into `.ps1`/`.sh`/`.py` |

dsh-delete-guard README · What it blocks：**Allowed**: read-only work, commands that only mention a delete word
(`Select-String -Pattern "Remove-Item"`, `Get-Content shred.exe`), and
**restoring** files out of the bin.

dsh-delete-guard README · Two tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `file_trash { paths, reason? }` | The only permitted way to delete. Moves to the Recycle Bin, reports per-path results, never falls back to a permanent erase |
| `trash_status { drive? }` | Item count and byte size of the bin on a volume, to confirm a deletion landed |

dsh-delete-guard README · Configuration：Override in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (`config` is replaced as a whole
block — restate every key you want to keep):

dsh-delete-guard README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch |
| `blockDestructiveCommands` | `true` | Intercept shell deletes and redirect to `file_trash` |
| `forbidEmptyRecycleBin` | `true` | Refuse emptying or modifying the bin |
| `forbidWipe` | `true` | Refuse `shred` / `sdelete` / `srm` / `cipher /w` / `format` |
| `blockScriptDeletes` | `true` | Refuse deletes in script files and inline strings |

dsh-delete-guard README · Restoring a deleted file：Restoring is not a plugin feature and needs none: the bin belongs to the OS.
Explorer's right-click "Restore" works. From a script, read the
`X:\$Recycle.Bin\<SID>\$I*` records (offset 24 = original path length in chars,
offset 28 = UTF-16LE path), match the one you want, and `Move-Item` its paired `$R`
file back. The `$R`/`$I` names are random, so those records are the only index;
skip any whose payload is missing. Do not depend on the localized verb name.

dsh-delete-guard README · What it does not cover：| Not covered | Why |
| --- | --- |
| Deletes already inside a script file | The guard never sees the body; it refuses the write and the inline forms it can see |
| Arbitrary C# through `Add-Type` (e.g. `DeleteFileW`) | Out of reach for text matching; only the bin-specific API is named and blocked |
| A command name assembled into a variable, then `& $c` | Cannot be evaluated textually |
| Execution channels outside the tool list (custom-named shells, third-party plugins) | The list is explicit — see below |
| A delete split across two terminal sends | Each send is judged on its own text |
| Non-Windows platforms | The bridge is `SHFileOperationW` |
| Free-space exhaustion | A same-volume NTFS recycle is a rename and consumes no space, so there is nothing to pre-check |

dsh-delete-guard README · What it does not cover：Covered shell tools: `pwsh`, `powershell`, `cmd`, `bash`, `sh`, `zsh`, `shell`,
`terminal_send`, `terminal_write`. Reasoning and measurements:
the decision is made on the statement's command word, the shape of the call, and program position — never on a word appearing somewhere in the line.

dsh-delete-guard README · Tests：```shell
node test/run-all.mjs
```

90 cases across five layers: command classification (49), `file_trash` operand
guard (15), host schema + hook wiring (11), host schema acceptance (5), live
end-to-end against the real Recycle Bin (10). `test/` is not shipped in the
tarball, so it must be green before packing; two layers load the host's own
validators and report **skipped** (not failed) where no DSH install exists.
